data.name: Tier 0
data.title: Business Foundation & Compliance
data.subtitle: Lay the groundwork for fundability. This phase ensures your business is properly formed, verified, and listed — including EIN registration, business phone, 411 listing, professional email, and virtual address setup. Lenders can’t approve what they can’t verify.
data.description:
Establish the legal and structural essentials required for business credit readiness and financial compliance.

Advancement Requirement: All items must be PASSED.

tiers.name: Tier 0
tiers.title: Business Foundation & Compliance
tiers.subtitle: Lay the groundwork for fundability. This phase ensures your business is properly formed, verified, and listed — including EIN registration, business phone, 411 listing, professional email, and virtual address setup. Lenders can’t approve what they can’t verify.
tiers.description:
Establish the legal and structural essentials required for business credit readiness and financial compliance.

Advancement Requirement: All items must be PASSED.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.title: Starter Vendor Accounts
tiers.subtitle: Open your first tradelines with vendors that report to the business credit bureaus. These small starter accounts help establish your business’s first credit history and build your D-U-N-S file.
tiers.description:
Open your first tradelines with vendors that report to the business credit bureaus.

Entry Criteria:
- Tier 0 complete
- NAV identity match
- No derogatories

Completion Criteria:
- 8–10 reporting tradelines (includes NAV reporting tradeline)
- 90+ days reporting history
- PAYDEX ≥ 80
- Zero late payments

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.title: Intermediate Vendors & Revolving Accounts
tiers.subtitle: Expand your credit profile with additional vendors and store/fleet accounts that report to multiple bureaus. This phase strengthens your payment history and boosts your credit depth.
tiers.description:
Expand your credit profile with additional vendors and store/fleet accounts.

Entry Criteria:
- Tier 1 complete
- ≥5 Tier-1 vendor tradelines reporting
- NAV profile stable

Completion Criteria:
- 3–5 Tier-2 tradelines
- 10–12 total reporting tradelines
- No lates
- NAV shows no negative activity

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.title: Fleet & Vehicle
tiers.subtitle: Transition from vendor credit to revolving business credit cards, higher limit Net 55/60 terms, and equipment or fleet financing. This tier proves long term creditworthiness and payment reliability.
tiers.description:
Transition to higher limit Net 55/60 terms and fleet financing.

Entry Criteria:
- Tier 2 complete
- ≥10 total tradelines
- Clean 12-month history
- NAV scores stable

Completion Criteria:
- 2–4 reporting fleet tradelines
- 14+ total reporting tradelines
- No derogatories

tiers.name: Tier 4
tiers.title: Bank & Institutional Lending
tiers.subtitle: Leverage your established credit history to access bank lines of credit, SBA loans, and corporate financing — often without a personal guarantee. This tier is where funding power meets independence.
tiers.description:
Access bank lines of credit and corporate financing.

Entry Criteria:
- Tier 3 complete
- ≥14 verified reporting tradelines
- No negative data in NAV or bureaus
- Meets revenue/TIB underwriting thresholds

Completion Criteria:
- PAYDEX ≥ 80
- Healthy Experian/Equifax
- 0 × 30-day lates
- Responsible utilization
- Fundability intact
